title: SignInRejected
description: server -> device, the reply to a rejected sign_in: account_token was invalid, expired, or already used ("invalid_token"), the account is at its device limit ("device_limit_reached", with devices listing the account's current devices so the app can show which one to replace), replace_device_id named a device that isn't one of the account's phones ("unknown_device"), or this server has no accounts ("accounts_unsupported").

devices.description: The account's current devices, sent with reason "device_limit_reached".

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 — when the server last heard from this device.
